text:
sophia: Heads-up, p99 for text-gen in us-west jumped from 180ms -> 620ms around 21:04 UTC. Dashboard shows a spike in batcher queue depth and continuous batching hitting soft cap.

andrew: seen it in logs, looks like observed batches at max at a lot of shards. probably eviction thrash.

sophia: exact metrics: `max_batch=32`, `avg_batch=30.8`, `queue_depth=1200`, `evictions/sec=18`, `admission_reject_rate=0.12`. Many requests get admitted then evicted and retried => tail blow-up.

raj: is this the usual packing for long-context jobs? any recent traffic shift?

andrew: traffic mix changed — more long convo sessions from a new partner region, sequence lengths up 2x. Batcher window still tuned for short job profile.

sophia: we hit two failure modes together: (1) continuous batching pumping up batch sizes to 32 (max) so KV cache refill + kernel path cost increases per token; (2) admission admission controller uses capacity tokens that assume avg latency, so when latency rises it doesn't throttle fast enough -> queue grows.

raj: mitigation idea: lower `runtime.max_batch` for latency-sensitive routes to 16 and enable stricter admission.QoS for `route=prod-text-gen`. also add `batcher.max_wait_ms=8` for that route.

andrew: +1. can we roll these as a dynamic config change (FF) rather than full deploy? safer.

sophia: yes we have config flags. can someone push a canary to 5 shards in us-west then monitor p99 and admitted rate?

raj: I'll prepare the flag: `flags: {"route.prod-text-gen.max_batch":16, "route.prod-text-gen.max_wait_ms":8, "route.prod-text-gen.qos":"high"}` and target shard set `us-west-a(5)`.

andrew: re-run admission simulation locally then push. running sim now. snippet: ```json
{"sim":true, "traffic_profile":"partner-long-context", "expected_p99_ms_before":620, "expected_p99_ms_after":240}```

infra-bot: Deploy plan created by raj — rolling flag canary to 5 shards in us-west-a. ID: plan-75321.

andrew: pushing plan-75321 to staging -> running smoke tests.

oncall-bot: Alert suppression enabled for incident-4392 during canary window (10m).

(andrew interrupts): staging looks good: p50/p95 stable, small drop in throughput ~6% (expected). pushing to production canary now.

infra-bot: Canary applied to shards [us-west-a-11, us-west-a-14, us-west-a-18, us-west-a-22, us-west-a-27].

sophia: metrics after 3m: p99 down to ~210ms on canary shards, admission_reject_rate reduced to 0.03, evictions/sec -> 2. Nice.

raj: propose to expand to 40% capacity and leave for 30m before full rollout. also open a backlog ticket to revisit batcher defaults and add auto-adaptive admission.

andrew: expanding to 40% now. I also kicked off a capacity check for spare GPUs in other zones as fallback. note: cost delta small because smaller batches -> lower packing efficiency.

sophia: for postmortem: we should surface partner traffic long-context signal to autoscaler so Dedicated pools can pre-warm or we can prefer models with faster per-token kernels.

raj: added follow-up: TICKET-1287 (Investigate adaptive max_batch heuristics + admission feedback loop).

infra-bot: plan-75321 expanded to 40% of us-west.

sophia: thanks all. keeping this thread open until full rollout. next steps: (1) monitor for 1h, (2) start postmortem draft if any regressions. :thumbsup:
